token_provenance.accent: frequency heuristic, most saturated, extracted as #e05300 then LIGHTENED to #ff7f33 (same hue, HLS lightness 0.44 -> 0.60) after the screening gate FAILed readability on the flash scene -- the extracted orange's grayscale luma (601-luma 115.7) sat just under the gate's 128 dark/light polarity threshold, so the gate misread the flash template's full-bleed accent field as a dark canvas needing bright ink, when the actual design is a bright accent field with dark canvas-colored text cut into it. Same failure class as the 2026-07-04 caveman entry in CRAFT_LOG (accent luma sitting on the boundary). Fixed at the token, not the renderer: #ff7f33 has 601-luma 156.4 (28pt clear of the boundary, matching the precedented fix's margin) and still clears accent/canvas contrast at 7.75:1 (was 5.04:1).

readability_plan.ink_floor: dark canvas, primary ink >= 230 luma (#f2f0eb clears this)
readability_plan.accent_as_graphic: raw #e05300 accent stays on aurora blobs / dots / diagram accent node / flash burst; any text-scale accent use relies on build_html's auto-derived --accent-ink
readability_plan.muted_carries_content: diagram node labels and terminal supporting lines use --muted-content, not raw --ink-muted
readability_plan.light_per_scene: title: hero headline at full ink brightness. two_line: accent_idx line lifts to accent-ink. terminal: prompt-line accent + bright ink body, widened pane per the 2026-07-03 light lesson. diagram: accent:true cloud node glows, labels in ink/muted-content. quote: bright ink quote text, generous scale. flash: accent-colored full-bleed burst -- the one inverted/bright beat. logo_reveal: bright hero wordmark + sheen.
readability_plan.inverted_beat: flash (scene 6) is the color-break: accent field burst instead of dark canvas
